title: List member servers
summary: Start a composer on an empty local store and print how many member servers it has.

title: Add a prompt
summary: Register one prompt template and print its name.

title: Publish a note
summary: Store a short text resource a client can read back by URI.

title: Mount a stdio server
summary: Start a local member server, list the tools it adds, and call one.

title: Import an OpenAPI spec
summary: Turn a local OpenAPI file into composer tools and print their names.

title: Describe look-alike tools
summary: Mount two box-counting tools whose descriptions say when not to use the other.

title: Hide a write tool
summary: Mount a count tool and a seal tool, then drop the write tool from the client list.

title: Choose a tool
summary: Score a short request against three tools and print resolved, fan-out, clarify, or no match.

title: Keep a skill across turns
summary: Match a skill from a message, keep it on the next turn, then add a second skill.
